title: AuthorizationReceipt
description: Normative schema for an immutable AuthorizationReceipt (M7). Proves a decision was authorized under correct conditions. Receipt-like, not decision-like.

receipt_id.description: UUIDv4 unique identifier for this AuthorizationReceipt

issuer.description: Identity of the authorizing agent (string; constrained enum reserved for later revision)

subject_decision_id.description: Identifier of the decision being authorized (exactly one)

authorization_context_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest over the contextual fields that justify authorization

supporting_evidence_hashes.description: Array of SHA-256 hex digests of supporting evidence

signature.description: Detached signature (opaque string; cryptographic algorithm not yet normative)
